_note: Community organizations (/community/): nonprofits, civic and service clubs, youth sports, school-connected groups (boosters, PTOs), scouts and 4-H, and history, arts and library groups. Hand-kept. Facts only from the group's own website or its parent organization's official page, each with a verified date. Public organizational contacts only (website, general email or phone): never name officers, coaches, volunteers or any child. Churches are in churches.json; businesses in the directory. Entries with an empty `verified` date are shown as not yet confirmed; `toConfirm` (not shown on the site) lists what the editor still needs to check. Checked monthly by scripts/check-resources.mjs.

items.name: Waynesville Youth Football & Cheerleading Association
items.what: Volunteer-run youth tackle football and cheerleading for 3rd through 6th graders; the feeder program for the junior high and high school teams.
items.meets: Fall season. Registration typically closes in mid-May; practice starts in late July.
items.howToHelp: Each family works one concession-stand shift at home games (or pays a buyout at registration).

items.name: Waynesville Baseball Softball Association
items.what: Recreational and Knothole baseball, softball and T-ball for Waynesville boys and girls.
items.meets: Spring season, at the Waynesville High School fields (659 Dayton Rd.) and Hisey Park (5443 Middletown Rd.). Registration opens in December.
items.howToHelp: Team, field and outfield banner sponsorships; volunteers are welcome, including help with the fields.

items.name: Waynesville Soccer Association
items.what: All-volunteer nonprofit running Waynesville's youth soccer: a SAY recreational program (SAY Miami Valley South) and the Waynesville Futbol Club competitive program.
items.meets: Fall recreational season; registration runs April to mid-June.

items.name: Waynesville Youth Wrestling Club
items.what: Youth wrestling club for Waynesville kids; see its Facebook page for the season and sign-ups.
items.toConfirm: Facebook page added from the editor's link (2026-11-07); Facebook can't be read from the session. Still needed: current ages (a 2018 district post said ages 5 through 6th grade), season and a public contact.

items.name: Waynesville Athletic Boosters
items.what: Volunteer nonprofit supporting Waynesville high school and junior high athletes, cheerleaders, trainers and coaches.
items.meets: Has met the 4th Monday of each month at 7 p.m. in the high school's Spartan Room; check with the boosters for this year's schedule.
items.howToHelp: Come to a meeting. Fundraisers include the Sauerkraut Festival food booth, the concession stand and field and gym banner sponsorships.

items.name: Waynesville Band Boosters
items.what: Parent group supporting Waynesville's school bands.
items.toConfirm: Facebook page added from the editor's link (2026-11-07); Facebook can't be read from the session. Still needed: meeting schedule and a public contact.

items.name: Waynesville Elementary PTO
items.what: Families, teachers and staff raising money for enrichment assemblies, art, computer, music and PE needs, and staff appreciation at Waynesville Elementary.
items.howToHelp: Volunteer for Book Fair, Field Day and the Holiday Shop by email or through Facebook.

items.name: Legacy 4-H Club
items.what: Warren County 4-H club in the Waynesville area.

items.name: Ridgeville Sunny Shamrocks 4-H Club
items.what: Warren County 4-H club in the Waynesville area.

items.name: Warren County Pioneers 4-H Club
items.what: Warren County 4-H club in the Waynesville area.

items.name: Mid Valley Wranglers 4-H Club
items.what: Warren County 4-H club serving the Lebanon and Waynesville areas.

items.name: Spurs & Steers 4-H Club
items.what: Warren County 4-H club serving the Lebanon and Oregonia areas.

items.name: Scouts BSA Troops 51 and 1051 and Venturing Crew 6151
items.what: Scouting America troops and a Venturing crew chartered to Waynesville Scouting, a local 501(c)(3); part of the Fort Ancient District of the Dan Beard Council.
items.meets: Every Wednesday (1st through 4th) at 7 p.m. at the American Legion.
items.howToHelp: Families interested in joining can email the troop or check its website; Waynesville Scouting accepts donations through the troop site.

items.name: American Legion Post 615
items.what: Veterans organization, with an Auxiliary unit, Sons of the American Legion and Legion Riders; Troops 51 and 1051 and Crew 6151 meet at the Legion.
items.toConfirm: Phone, email and address are from its Chamber listing; confirm they're current. Facebook page added from the editor's link (2026-11-07); Facebook can't be read from the session, so nothing was taken from it.

items.name: Waynesville Leo Club
items.what: Youth service club in the Lions Clubs International family, chartered in 2023; named District 13 OH 6 Leo Club of the Year in 2024.

items.name: Waynesville Lions Club
items.what: Lions service club since 1958: sight-related causes, scholarships, Student of the Month and Citizen of the Year, a pancake breakfast for the Waynesville Food Pantry, and a food trailer at the Sauerkraut Festival.
items.meets: 2nd and 4th Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m., Wayne Township Admin Building, 6050 N. Clarksville Rd.
items.contact: Contact form on the club website

items.name: Waynesville Masonic Lodge No. 163 F&AM
items.what: Freemasons lodge (Grand Lodge of Ohio) for men 19 and older.
items.meets: First Tuesday of each month at 7 p.m. (not July or August), 1351 Lytle Rd., Waynesville.
items.howToHelp: Use the "Interested in joining?" form on the lodge's Grand Lodge of Ohio page.

items.name: Order of the Eastern Star, Miami Chapter No. 107
items.what: Eastern Star chapter affiliated with Waynesville Masonic Lodge No. 163.
items.meets: First Monday of each month at 7:30 p.m. (not July or August).

items.name: Progressive Women's Club of Waynesville
items.what: Women's community service and education club, with a foundation; holds a spring silent auction.
items.sourceNote: Active, per the editor (2026-11-07); the Facebook page is its only online presence. Meeting place not listed.

items.name: Waynesville Food Pantry and Wayne Township Community Aid
items.what: Free food and household items, plus help with utility bills, for Waynesville, Wayne Township, Corwin, Harveysburg, Lytle and Oregonia. Distribution Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, 3–4:30 p.m., at St. Mary's Episcopal Church, 107 S. Third St.
items.howToHelp: Drop off non-expired, non-perishable food at the pantry during open hours, at the Mary L. Cook Library, or in the Wayne Township Fire Station lobby (open 24/7). No clothing or furniture.

items.name: Waynesville Area Arts Council
items.what: Local arts group behind community art programs, including workshops at the Mary L. Cook Public Library (such as the Gingerbread 101 workshop) and Art Class for Kids with the library.
items.toConfirm: Facebook page from the editor's link (2026-11-07); Facebook can't be read from the session. The programs come from the library's calendar. Still needed: what else it runs, how to join or volunteer, and a public contact.

items.name: Caesar's Creek Pioneer Village
items.what: Volunteer-run, privately funded living-history village of historic buildings moved from the Caesar Creek area, on land leased in Caesar Creek State Park.
items.meets: Grounds open dawn to dusk daily; buildings open during events such as the pancake brunch, craft show and Candlelight Walk. 3999 Pioneer Village Rd.
items.contact: Contact form on the website; P.O. Box 652, Waynesville
items.howToHelp: Volunteer, donate or become a member through the website.

items.name: Friends of the Mary L. Cook Public Library
items.what: Library support group behind the book sale and the holiday auction.
items.toConfirm: Contact, membership details and the library page (the library's site was down when checked).

items.name: Museum at the Friends Home
items.what: All-volunteer local history museum in a 1905 Quaker boarding house, preserving the history of Waynesville and nearby northeast Warren County villages.
items.meets: Open Wednesdays and Saturdays, 1–5 p.m., and by appointment, 115 S. Fourth St.
items.howToHelp: Volunteer, donate or become a member through the museum's website.

items.name: Ohio Sauerkraut Festival
items.what: Annual October street festival on Main Street. Its food vendors are local nonprofits, and proceeds support area civic and charitable groups.

items.name: Waynesville Area Chamber of Commerce
items.what: Business association that promotes Waynesville's shops, restaurants and events, including Christmas in the Village, and hosts member networking events.
items.howToHelp: Membership information on the Chamber's website.

items.name: Waynesville Merchants Association
items.what: Group of downtown merchants promoting Waynesville's local businesses and historic downtown, including the Waynesville Street Faire.

items.name: Waynesville Blue Dolphins
items.what: Board-run summer youth swim team for swimmers of all levels, focused on building skills, strength and speed. Practice groups for 10 and under and 11 and older, plus a program for swimmers 6 and under at meets.
items.meets: Summer season. Practices Monday through Thursday, 60 minutes; meets usually Tuesday and Thursday evenings (6–7 a season, optional).
items.howToHelp: Families take part through the team's volunteer program; details on the website.

items.name: Waynesville Youth Basketball Association
items.what: Competitive youth basketball club that serves as a feeder program for the Wayne Local middle and high school teams, teaching basic and advanced skills, teamwork and sportsmanship.
items.contact: Email form on the club's website
items.toConfirm: Grades, season and registration dates: the club's site lists none (checked 2026-11-07). A January 2023 district post described grades 2 through 6.

items.name: Waynesville Lacrosse Club
items.what: Youth lacrosse for boys and girls: teams for 3rd/4th grade, 5th/6th grade, middle school and high school, plus a co-ed K–2 fun league. The season runs early February through mid-May.
items.howToHelp: Spring 2027 registration is open on the club's website; register before November 30, 2026 to avoid a late fee.

items.name: The Bridge
items.what: Non-denominational community outreach on North Street: a free food pantry, free showers and laundry, free counseling (Fridays, by appointment), community dinners, a shoe and coat giveaway, Your Dress Their Dream, office and study space, and social evenings for games and conversation.
items.meets: Thursdays 1–4 p.m.; Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays by appointment between 9 a.m. and 4 p.m. (email to schedule). Closed Saturday (except special events), Sunday and Monday. 275 North St., Waynesville.
